exercises.instruction: Заполните пропуски. Используйте I’ll (I will) + глаголы из рамки:

answers: I’ll carry
I’ll eat
I’ll sit
I’ll do
I’ll stay
I’ll show

exercises.instruction: Заполните пропуски. Используйте I think I’ll ... или I don’t think I’ll ... + глаголы из рамки:

answers: I don’t think I’ll go
I think I’ll have
I don’t think I’ll play
I think I’ll buy
I don’t think I’ll buy

options: I watch a lot of sport on TV
I’ll watch a lot of sport on TV
Carl is going to buy a new car.
Carl will buy a new car.
I’m going to give it to her.

Are you doing anything this evening? Yes, I’m going out with some friends.

exercises.instruction: Напишите предложения с Shall I ... ? Используйте слова из обеих рамок.

items.prompt: It’s very warm in this room.
answers: Shall I open the window?
Shall I turn off the TV?
Shall I make some sandwiches?
Shall I turn on the light?

exercises.instruction: Напишите предложения с Shall we ... ? Используйте слова из обеих рамок.

answers: OK, what time shall we meet?
OK, where shall we go?
OK, what shall we buy?
OK, who shall we invite?

exercises.instruction: Переведите предложения на английский язык, используя will или shall. (приносить = bring, свободен = free)

answers: I’ll bring you a chair.
I will bring you a chair.
I’ll get you a chair.
I will get you a chair.

answers: I don’t think we’ll go on holiday this year.
